description: A couple trades places under a raised hand, turning the other way round.

walkthrough.line: Take inside hands with {who} and raise them; the two of you trade places under the arch.
walkthrough.teach: Join inside hands with {who} and raise them into an arch. One of you turns under it while the other walks forward and round the outside, and the two of you trade places. You end side by side again, facing back the way you came, hands joined the whole way through.
